The '''Great Sacrifice''' was the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] vision of the final destruction of the universe. Believed by every [[Warrior caste|warrior]] that they would be given a special position at the Great Sacrifice, depending on their exploits during their life. The Great Sacrifice idea was modified when [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] planned to sacrifice [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to the [[Yun'o|True Gods]], in order to ensure the success of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
